service_boundary: Represents Fireworks-hosted model APIs and deployments, not model publishers, Fireworks client libraries, or customer-operated inference runtimes.
regional_controls: Regional and private deployment options are enterprise- and deployment-specific; public serverless placement is not universally customer-selected.
retention_controls: Data handling follows Fireworks terms and feature-specific behavior for serverless inference, batch files, fine-tunes, and deployments.
routing: Customers select a model or deployment; Fireworks manages serving capacity rather than routing to unrelated upstream providers.
customization: Fine-tuning, LoRA, custom models, and dedicated deployments are documented for supported formats.
strengths: Multiple capacity modes support both bursty and predictable workloads.
OpenAI-compatible APIs cover a broad hosted model catalog.
tradeoffs: Production controls depend on deployment tier and contract.
Publisher terms and model lifecycle remain model-specific.
